newsitem.title: USA: Gantos January same-store sales down.
newsitem.headline: Gantos January same-store sales down.

text.p: Gantos Inc said Thursday same-store sales for the four-week period ended February 1 fell five percent.
The company said total sales for the period were $9.2 million, a decrease of four percent from sales of $9.7 million for the four-week period ended January 27, 1996.
Adjusting for the shift in the retail calendar, comparable store sales for the four, thirteen and fifty-two week periods decreased six percent, five percent and three percent, respectively.
Gantos, Inc is a specialty retailer of women's wear and accessories.
